title: private-deployments-weekly-2026-09-21
content:
Private Deployments — Weekly Sync (2026-09-21)
Owners: Maya Chen (notes), Aiden Park, Priya Nair
Attendees: Maya, Aiden, Priya, Diego, Rahul (SRE), Caroline (Solutions)

Summary / Highlights:
- Two on-prem installs completed (Customer A staged, Customer B pilot live in prod-like env).
- VPC peering failures for Customer C persisted, blocking network cutover — escalated to infra networking.
- Installer v1.3.0 beta rolled to internal lab; initial telemetry shows ~15% faster bootstrap and fewer cert issues.
- New automated preflight checks added (network ranges, MTU, firewall rules) — still in dev, will be default in v1.4.

Standups / Individual updates:
- Maya: customer A final validation done, working on post-install config script to pin KMS keys. TODO: upload final manifest to Confluence.
- Aiden: installer fixes for windows nodes (service user perms) merged to feature branch; integration tests flakey on node-restart case. Investigating race with systemd ordering.
- Priya: documentation PR for air-gapped install in review (CONFLUENCE-1234). Need one more review from Security before merging.
- Diego: working with infra-net on Customer C peering — found that route table propagation disabled on their account. Opening runbook for network checklist.
- Rahul (SRE): observed KV cache warmup taking longer on large-model workloads; added metrics to trace and will run stress tests this week.

Customer-specific status / blockers:
- Customer C (large enterprise, multi-region): Blocker - VPC peering failing due to missing route propagation and asymmetric firewall rules. Impact: cannot cutover; ETA dependent on customer infra team's approval (~2–3 business days). Action: Diego to coordinate with Solutions lead to schedule joint call; Aiden to prepare a deterministic diagnostic script.
- Customer D (regulated, on-prem): Installer succeeded but HSM integration failing during keywrap step. Error: HSM returns CKR_HOST_MEMORY intermittently. Workaround found (retry with exponential backoff) but need durable root cause. Action: Priya to log HSM vendor support ticket and add retry logic to installer.
- Customer E (SaaS vendor, small): Completed VPC setup; minor TLS mismatch due to SNI settings. Resolved by updating proxy config. No further action.

Engineering / Infra work in progress:
- Installer v1.4 roadmap: add preflight checks, HSM retries, better logging and deterministic exit codes. Target: feature-complete by 2026-10-05.
- Telemetry: add install-duration and cert-rotation success metrics to the console. Diego + Rahul to draft metric schema.
- Autoscaling for private clusters: POC for on-prem horizontal scaling using k3s + lightweight scheduler ongoing; initial results promising but still manual.

Risks & Open Questions:
- Air-gapped preflight coverage: do we need to ship a compressed supplemental bundle for offline dependency verification? Impact: increases package size but reduces manual steps. Input from Solutions required.
- HSM vendor variance: multiple customers have different HSMs (AWS CloudHSM, Thales Luna, SoftHSM). Should we maintain a compatibility matrix and formal certification process?
- SRE: KV cache warmup could impact cold-start latency for large models on private deployments — plan to add warmup hook or persistent snapshotting.

Action Items (owners):
- Diego: Schedule joint troubleshooting call with Customer C and infra-net (due 2026-09-22).
- Aiden: Diagnostic script for peering + route checks (JIRA-PD-412) and push flaky integration-test fix (due 2026-09-24).
- Priya: File vendor HSM ticket + update installer retry logic (JIRA-PD-398) (due 2026-09-25).
- Maya: Upload final Customer A manifest and post-install runbook to Confluence (CONFLUENCE-1234) (due 2026-09-23).
- Rahul: Run KV cache warmup stress tests and report results (due 2026-09-26).

Notes / Misc (choppy / working doc style):
- Remember to add default MTU recommendations to troubleshooting page — saw two customers with jumbo frames disabled that caused fragmentation.
- Consider exposing preflight CLI flag to skip DNS checks (helpful for air-gapped installs).
- Put reminder to talk to Product about adding "installer success" webhook for partner automation.

Next meeting: 2026-09-28, 10:00 PT — focus on installer v1.4 milestone and Customer C unblock plan.

Attachments / Links:
- Installer branch: github.com/redwood-inference/private-installer/compare/v1.3...v1.4
- Runbook draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PD/On-Prem+Install+Runbook
- Relevant JIRAs: JIRA-PD-412, JIRA-PD-398

-- end of notes --
